meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 OpenCode 配置管理多种 AI 模型提供商
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器化环境中切换不同 AI 模型提供商
copy.tagline_en: Manage multiple AI model providers via OpenCode config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to switch between AI model providers in containerized environments

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 的 agent 可以选择 OpenCode 作为后台,从而调用 DeepSeek、OpenRouter 或 Anthropic 等模型,而不只限于默认 Claude。技能会复制代码、装依赖并重建镜像。
howto.when: 当你想改用 OpenCode 作为后台,或要求接入 DeepSeek、OpenRouter 等模型时触发;技能会检查缺少的文件并补齐,再进入配置。

say.note: 会更新配置并重启分组

say.text: 帮我通过 OpenCode 接入 DeepSeek 模型

howto.what_en: After installing, NanoClaw's agent can use OpenCode as backend, calling models like DeepSeek, OpenRouter, or Anthropic instead of default Claude. The skill copies code, installs dependencies, and rebuilds the image.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to switch the agent provider to OpenCode or connect DeepSeek/OpenRouter etc. It checks missing files and guides configuration.

say_en.text: Set the agent provider to OpenCode.
say_en.note: Updates config and restarts the group.
